hooks.command: f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/settings.json"; if [ -f "$f" ] && grep -qE 'gh pr create|pr-lifecycle' "$f"; then exit 0; fi; command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' | grep -Eq '(^|[;&|(]|&&)[[:space:]]*gh[[:space:]]+pr[[:space:]]+create([[:space:]]|$)' || exit 0; jq -cn --arg ctx 'A pull request was just created, and this repo has no PR hook of its own. If CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md or the engineering docs of this repo name a review bot or a review policy, follow them. Otherwise run a local review of this PR now (a code-review skill, or a reviewer sub-agent on the PR diff), report the findings, and fix confirmed issues on the PR branch before handing it over.' '{hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PostToolUse", additionalContext: $ctx}}'
